primary_task: Obtain base/head git SHAs for finished work and dispatch a general-purpose code-reviewer subagent filled from the code-reviewer.md template, then act on its feedback.

requirements.name: git
requirements.evidence: BASE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)  # or: git merge-base origin/main HEAD
requirements.basis: bash: ... build, test, run CLIs and scripts, git, gh, start and stop local servers inside the session

requirements.name: sub-agent dispatch (general-purpose)
requirements.evidence: Dispatch a `general-purpose` subagent, filling the template at [code-reviewer.md](code-reviewer.md)
requirements.basis: agent: start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them

requirements.name: code-reviewer.md template file
requirements.basis: skill: load an installed Claude Code skill; the manifest does not say the skill's bundled template is present

requirements.name: git repository with commits (and origin/main for the alternative)
requirements.basis: grants: local_filesystem; repository state not stated

notes: The example refers to docs/superpowers/plans/deployment-plan.md, an illustration only. The general-purpose agent type is assumed to exist. Unknowns do not block.
